events.title: Pisgah Rage Pre-season
events.description: Pre-season activities including social events, rider assessment, bike shop night, parent meeting, and adventure rides in Bent Creek or Dupont

events.title: Pisgah Rage Regular Season
events.description: Regular season with indoor training (January), weekend practices (February onwards), and 5-6 races across North Carolina starting in March. Races held on Saturdays (pre-ride) and Sundays (racing). Multiple weekly rides March-May.
events.venue: Asheville area and across North Carolina
